description: Stage B: link failures L1-L6 under 0/5/40 Mb/s background UDP (PC-SHOP->SRV-LOCAL), 3 independent repetitions each, plus no-fault controls at each load. 3 repetitions: signatures are deterministic in the v1 campaign (identical across 3 reps); a 4th adds cost without new coverage. Loads x links x reps = 54 fault runs + 9 controls.
